scripts.dev:electron: tsup electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --out-dir dist-electron --external electron --external ffmpeg-static --watch
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:next" "npm run dev:electron" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron ."
scripts.build:electron: tsup electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --out-dir dist-electron --external electron --external ffmpeg-static
scripts.build: npm run build:next && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.build:exe: npm run build:next && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win nsis
scripts.build:appx: npm run build:next && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win appx
